api.notes: Completed the previously unexported helper from Claude commit d8e6761fe; validated against pinned OCCT. Six Rust behavior tests and 274 differential cases cover camera identity, orthographic/perspective depth conventions, viewport reset, signed plane distance, finite/void depth ranges, insertion-order merging, clipping plane chains, disabled planes, parallel/opposite picking rays, and DumpJson. GetNearestDepth maps to the output-argument form so both success and failure preserve native depth mutations; the Option-returning convenience method remains available. Contract audit 2026-10-12: native Camera() returns a const Handle reference to the actual retained camera slot (stable static empty slot for a null manager). Current Rust returns an owning copied Handle, changing intrusive counts and losing retained-slot replacement observation. Genuine live field aliases remain to be integrated; setter callback proofs do not establish this getter contract. Restored actual getter contract only: weak alias captures genuine camera field once, retains no source/camera owner or lock, follows target replacement; manager captures selected volume or one genuine shared static null slot. Native30 exact identity/count/retarget/failure/retry rows plus Rust-only expiration/explicitownership regressions. Old copied camera convenience is unclaimed. Constructors/classes and full Frame remain partial. See docs/selectmgr-camera-getters.md.
